description: Guided, discovery-driven setup of Claude code-review GitHub Actions on any repo

eval_dimensions.name: Phase 2 Module Selection Gate
eval_dimensions.description: Module selection uses AskUserQuestion (multiSelect, split across two questions per the 4-option GH-713 cap), not plain text, and every module remains independently skippable.

eval_dimensions.name: Phase 3 Strategy Decision Gate
eval_dimensions.description: Each strategy decision presents pros/cons per option and a recommended default before asking via AskUserQuestion, batching related decisions into one call.

eval_dimensions.name: Discovery-Driven Roster and Globs
eval_dimensions.description: Path globs and the reviewer roster are derived from Phase 1 discovery findings, never copied from a reference project or hardcoded to a Python-shaped stack.

eval_dimensions.name: Zero Project-Identifying Strings Guardrail
eval_dimensions.description: Generated workflows, prompts, and routing tables contain zero project-identifying strings from any source project; Phase 5 runs a grep gate to confirm before declaring done.

eval_dimensions.name: Lessons-Learned Module Hard Guardrails
eval_dimensions.description: When the lessons-learned module is selected, scope-lock, sanitization, size-budget, and single-open-draft-PR-lock are all mandatory, not optional add-ons.

eval_dimensions.name: Secrets Printed, Never Created
eval_dimensions.description: The skill prints exactly which secrets to add and where, but never creates a secret itself (v1 guardrail).

evals.name: Module selection uses AskUserQuestion with multiSelect, split into two questions
evals.description: Phase 2 must present the six modules across two AskUserQuestion questions (core + add-ons) in one call, each pre-checked per discovery defaults, never picking modules automatically.
evals.input: /Dev10x:gh-review-setup on a repo with no existing .claude/ review automation

assertions.signal: module_gate_uses_tool — Phase 2 module menu uses AskUserQuestion with multiSelect across two questions (core + add-ons)
modules_skippable — Every module is independently skippable; ADR/hygiene skip is first-class, not treated as an error

evals.name: Strategy decisions batch into one call with pros/cons and a recommended default
evals.description: Phase 3 must call AskUserQuestion for each strategy decision the user hasn't pre-stated, batching 1-4 related decisions per call, with each option's description carrying pros/cons.
evals.input: /Dev10x:gh-review-setup — user selected code review + PR hygiene modules in Phase 2

assertions.signal: strategy_gate_uses_tool — Phase 3 strategy decisions (depth, model tiering, action pinning, etc.) use AskUserQuestion
options_carry_tradeoffs — Each option description carries pros/cons; one option is marked recommended

evals.name: On an auto-advance effect, gates auto-select but still emit the tool call
evals.description: A resolve_gate(gate="strategy_choice") effect of auto-advance pre-selects the recommended option for each gate, but the skill must still emit the AskUserQuestion tool call so the user retains override capability — it must not silently skip the call, and it must not read session policy itself.

assertions.signal: adaptive_still_calls_tool — AskUserQuestion is still called for each strategy decision even though the recommended option is pre-selected

evals.name: Non-Python repo produces globs and a roster matching discovery, not a Python default
evals.description: Running on a repo whose Phase 1 discovery finds only shell + markdown + workflow-yaml must not scaffold Python-specific reviewers or globs.
evals.input: /Dev10x:gh-review-setup on a config-only repo (shell + markdown + workflow-yaml, no .py files)

assertions.signal: globs_from_discovery — Generated path globs match the discovered file types, not a fixed Python set
roster_from_discovery — Only reviewers for present domains are scaffolded; no Python/migration reviewer rows on a config repo

evals.name: Phase 5 sanitization grep gate reports zero project-identifying strings
evals.description: Before declaring done, Phase 5 must run the grep gate from references/sanitization.md over every rendered file and report zero hits, with repo slugs rendered as the GitHub Actions expression rather than a literal slug.
evals.input: /Dev10x:gh-review-setup completes Phase 4 scaffolding and reaches Phase 5

assertions.signal: sanitization_grep_gate — Phase 5 runs a grep gate over rendered files and reports zero hits before hand-off
repo_slug_is_expression — Repo slugs render as ${{ github.repository }}, never a literal source repo slug

evals.name: Lessons-learned selection ships all four mandatory guardrails
evals.description: Selecting the lessons-learned module must produce a scope-locked, sanitized, size-budgeted workflow with the single-open-draft-PR lock — none of the four is optional.
evals.input: /Dev10x:gh-review-setup — user selects Lessons-Learned with draft-PR destination in Phase 2/3

assertions.signal: scope_lock_present — Auto-apply allowlist limited to CLAUDE.md + .claude/ + references/; never skills/ or workflow files
single_pr_lock_present — Fixed lessons branch + existing-open-PR check prevents parallel lessons-learned PRs
size_budgets_and_sanitization — Per-file size budgets and prose+code domain-name sanitization are embedded in the rendered workflow prompt

evals.name: Phase 5 prints required secrets without creating any
evals.description: The skill must list which secrets to add and where, but never call a secret-creation API or CLI command.
evals.input: /Dev10x:gh-review-setup selects a module requiring an API key (e.g., second-opinion)

assertions.signal: secrets_printed_not_created — Phase 5 lists required secret names and where to add them; no secret-creation call is made

should_trigger: set up Claude code review on this repo
